typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		posting_direction_code as string,
		posting_direction as string,
		posting_direction_short as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT      fieldvalue AS posting_direction_code, xlatlongname AS posting_direction, xlatshortname AS posting_direction_short FROM         [ps_hcm].[xlattable] WHERE     (fieldname = \'APP_VISIBLE\')',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		posting_direction_key as short,
		posting_direction_code as string,
		posting_direction as string,
		posting_direction_short as string,
		internal_external as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from hr.dim_posting_direction',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(OLEDBSource@posting_direction_code == LookupLKPTABLE@posting_direction_code,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		posting_direction_code = OLEDBSource@posting_direction_code,
		posting_direction = OLEDBSource@posting_direction,
		posting_direction_short = OLEDBSource@posting_direction_short,
		posting_direction_key = posting_direction_key,
		internal_external = internal_external
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupSelect
LookupSelect split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupIsMatch@Match sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		{} = Param_0)) ~> OLEDBCommand
LookupIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		posting_direction_code as string,
		posting_direction_short as string,
		posting_direction as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		posting_direction_code,
		posting_direction_short,
		posting_direction)) ~> OLEDBDestination
